image_description: A high-angle shot of a Nile crocodile swimming in murky, brownish water. The crocodile's head and upper back are visible above the surface, showing textured, armored skin with prominent osteoderms. A log and some hanging dry vegetation are visible in the background.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers to a distinct point, consistent with the V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The mouth is fully closed and the angle prevents visibility of the tooth line or interlocking mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are clearly positioned on the top of the skull. While pupil shape is hard to resolve at this distance, the dorsal positioning is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are visible at the anterior end of the snout.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the body shows significant length and heavy armor plating.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony scutes are clearly visible running down the spine.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration is earthy brown/grey and texture appears rough and calcified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The ventral side is submerged and not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are mostly submerged or obscured by the body angle; digit count cannot be verified.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail extends out of the frame or is submerged; full length and compression cannot be verified.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight unnatural smoothing/plastic-like sheen on the water immediately adjacent to the snout, lacking fine ripple detail compared to the rest of the water.
Vegetation exhibits a painterly, smeared blur typical of generative models struggling with fine, complex linear structures against a background.

alignment_reasoning: The image strongly conforms to the 'African crocodile' class. All testable checkpoints regarding head shape, eye position, nostril placement, and dorsal scute arrangement are present and accurate. Non-testable checkpoints (teeth, ventral scales, limbs, tail) are occluded but do not contradict the classification. The subject is biologically plausible and taxonomically correct.
artifact_reasoning: The image is largely artifact-free with realistic lighting and anatomy. Minor issues include slight texture smearing in the water near the subject and painterly blur in the background vegetation, which are common subtle AI artifacts but do not significantly degrade the overall structural integrity.

metadata.class_label: African crocodile, Nile crocodile, Crocodylus niloticus
